messages:
emma: hi all, I'm Emma (day 1). Followed the onboarding doc but my kubeconfig shows contexts 'local', 'ci', and an old 'personal-cluster'. I ran the cloud login but I still can't list pods in my namespace team-emma (Forbidden). Who do I ask for RBAC?
lee-infra: welcome Emma! pinging infra. Quick check: paste `kubectl config get-contexts` and `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n team-emma`. Also which cloud (AWS/GCP)?
emma: AWS. `kubectl config get-contexts` -> local, ci, personal-cluster. No redwood-dev. I ran `aws eks update-kubeconfig --name redwood-dev --region us-west-2 --alias redwood-dev` and now context appears but `kubectl get pods -n team-emma` -> Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden.
kube-bot: created ticket ONB-9982 for emma: request RoleBinding for namespace team-emma.
lee-infra: looks like you're not in the `redwood-developers` SSO group yet. I can create an onboarding RoleBinding rb-emma-onboard bound to your SSO email for the next 7 days. Confirm SSO email?
emma: emma@redwood.ai
lee-infra: done 12; RoleBinding rb-emma-onboard created, bound to group `redwood-developers-onboard`. Wait ~20s then run `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-emma`. If you still see Unauthorized, run `aws sso login --profile redwood` to refresh token.
emma: `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-emma` -> yes. `kubectl get pods -n team-emma` -> No resources found. Thanks! Two follow-ups: 1) how to set default namespace on the context? 2) secrets access?
devx: 1) run `kubectl config set-context redwood-dev --namespace=team-emma` or `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=team-emma`. 2) secrets are separate: open a secrets request with justification and TTL; security approves short-lived access during onboarding.
maria-sec: echo devx. We'll review secrets requests; include why you need them and for how long.
emma: thanks everyone, cleaned my kubeconfig with `kubectl config view --minify --flatten > ~/.kube/config` to remove the stale personal user entry, that helped with earlier confusing auth errors. All set :smile:
